desktop.title: Shadow
desktop.web.label: Web lookups:
desktop.top.judge_backup: judged blind by both models (backup judging)
desktop.top.watch: Switch from test {test} ({word}) · {when} · all at once, because {new} is on {provider}
desktop.empty.intro: Pick one of your models and Shadow re-runs 30 of your recent turns on it and on your current model. A third model compares each pair without knowing which is which. You get one answer, and you can check any turn yourself.
desktop.empty.step1: You see where your text will go and what it costs before anything runs.
desktop.empty.step2: Nothing in a test writes files, sends messages or runs commands.
desktop.empty.step3: If you switch, it happens a little at a time, and you can undo it.
desktop.empty.web_body: Searches and page fetches run for real during a test, so research turns are judged fairly. Each turn's first result is saved, so both models read the same page. Turn it off and those turns stop at the lookup, the same way for both models.
desktop.empty.idle: Shadow is idle. It reads nothing and records nothing until you start a test.
desktop.progress.heading: Testing: {done} of {picked} turns done
desktop.progress.busy: this chat is busy until it finishes
desktop.progress.running: Running: {count} on {provider} for {whose}, {max} at most overall
desktop.progress.slow: {provider} asked Shadow to slow down. Waiting {seconds}s, then going on.
desktop.progress.hidden_title: Results show when all {picked} are done
desktop.progress.hidden_1: A lead after a few turns is mostly luck. Seeing it early makes the rest harder to read fairly, so wins and losses stay hidden until the end.
desktop.progress.hidden_2: You can open any finished turn now to read both answers. Which model wrote which stays hidden.
desktop.progress.open_hint: Open a finished turn to read both answers.

desktop.bar.label: Won {won}, same {same}, lost {lost}
desktop.verdict.other_provider: {trying} is on another provider ({provider}), so the switch can't be gradual. Shadow watches the next 20 turns and switches back if it breaks. That catches breakage, not a small drop.

desktop.switch.paused: You're back on {old}. The switch is paused.
desktop.switch.meters_title: How far from the rollback line
desktop.switch.rule: Shadow switches back if 3 requests fail in a row, or if {new} has trouble on 4 or more turns and its rate is 20 points above {old}'s. Shadow reads your turns only until this switch ends.

desktop.log.start: Started at 1 time in 10 from test {test} ({word}, won {won}, same {same}, lost {lost})
desktop.log.step: Moved to {share} after {turns} of its turns with no trip
desktop.log.watch_start: Default set to {new} on {provider}, from test {test} ({word}, won {won}, same {same}, lost {lost}). {old} on {old_provider} saved for undo.
desktop.watch.heading_clean: Watching {new}: {done} of {need} turns, no trouble yet
desktop.watch.heading: Watching {new}: {done} of {need} turns, trouble on {trouble}
desktop.watch.sub: Your default model is now {new} (was {old}). It's on another provider, so the switch happened all at once.
desktop.watch.tripped: You're back on {old}, and it's your default again.
desktop.watch.no_compare: No comparison with {old} here: Shadow keeps no record of your turns from before the switch.
desktop.watch.meters_title: How far from the switch-back line
desktop.watch.rule: Shadow switches back if 3 requests fail in a row, or if 5 of the first 20 turns have trouble. That catches breakage, not a small drop. Shadow reads your turns only until the watch ends.
